sql:
SELECT s.School AS School_Name, s.Phone AS Communication_Number, ss.AvgScrWrite AS Average_Score_Writing
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-01-01' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
AND ss.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
